sample.description: 10 ETFs SPY XLB XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLU XLV XLY daily prices Jan4 2010-Dec31 2024 from market_data/yfinance (3774 trading days, paper reports ~3770; 10 ETFs exact); simulation DGP fBm/fOU Delta=1/250 kappa=2,5 H=0.1-0.4 via Davies-Harte FFT with burn-in 500; Wold coefficients via Szego-Hurwitz zeta on midpoint grid N=16384

not_rebuilt.est_fBm_H_SPY: Requires 5-min TAQ RV Whittle estimator (Fukasawa-Takabatake 2019); public daily OHLC proxy cannot give fBm Hurst, se includes analytic asymptotic covariance
not_rebuilt.se_fBm_H_SPY: Requires same Whittle analytic covariance; not available without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.est_fOU_H_SPY: Requires 5-min TAQ RV fOU ML (Wang-Xiao-Yu-Zhang 2025) Delta=1/250 per year; not available without TAQ panel
not_rebuilt.se_fOU_H_SPY: Same fOU ML asymptotic covariance; not available
not_rebuilt.est_fOU_kappa_SPY: Requires fOU ML kappa per year; not available without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.se_fOU_kappa_SPY: Same fOU ML SE; not available
not_rebuilt.est_AR_rho_SPY: Requires OLS on 5-min log RV; public daily squared-return proxy gives different persistence (proxy rho ~0.12 vs 0.8058)
not_rebuilt.se_AR_rho_SPY: OLS SE counterpart to est_AR_rho_SPY; not rebuilt without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.est_RAR_rho_SPY: Requires RAR ML (Kalman) on 5-min log RV; daily proxy theta ~-0.9 rho ~0.97 vs paper -0.4111/0.9331
not_rebuilt.se_RAR_rho_SPY: RAR OPG SE counterpart; not available without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.est_RAR_theta_SPY: Headline RAR MA(1) requires 5-min TAQ log RV ML via Kalman (paper -0.4111 SE 0.0167); daily proxy is more negative due to higher measurement noise
not_rebuilt.se_RAR_theta_SPY: OPG SE of est_RAR_theta_SPY; not available without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.est_HAR_rho1_SPY: Requires HAR OLS on 5-min log RV with weekly/monthly averages; daily proxy distorted
not_rebuilt.est_HAR_rho2_SPY: Same HAR OLS; not rebuilt without TAQ RV
not_rebuilt.est_RHAR_rho1_SPY: Requires RHAR ML on 5-min log RV; daily proxy not comparable
not_rebuilt.est_RHAR_theta_SPY: Requires RHAR ML on 5-min log RV (paper -0.1789); daily proxy more negative
not_rebuilt.est_fBm_H_XLB: Same Whittle on 5-min RV for XLB; not available without TAQ
not_rebuilt.est_AR_rho_XLB: Requires AR OLS on 5-min RV for XLB
not_rebuilt.est_RAR_theta_XLE: Requires RAR ML for XLE most negative (paper -0.4757)
not_rebuilt.rel_MSE_1d_avg_HAR: Requires rolling 500-day forecast evaluation on 5-min RV panel (10 ETFs x 10 models x 3 horizons); needs TAQ RV, RQ, BPV, semivariances not in market_data
not_rebuilt.rel_MSE_1d_avg_LogRAR: Same rolling forecast; paper 0.7888 headline ~21% gain at 1-day
not_rebuilt.mcs_p_MSE_1d_SPY_HAR: Requires MCS block bootstrap 5000 reps block 20 on forecast losses; needs full RV forecast panel
not_rebuilt.est_noise_theta_SPY: Measurement-error state-space y=x+w x=phi x(-1)+v+theta v(-1) sigma_w2=1/39 fixed; requires known-variance Kalman on 5-min RV; paper ~-0.4 with 95% CI

sample.substitutions: Vendor/vintage proxy for same observations: TAQ 5-min RV (M=78, 6.5h, RV=sum r^2, RQ=M/3 sum r^4, BPV=mu1^{-2} sum|r||r+|, RS+/-) proxied by daily OHLC from market_data/yfinance (adjusted close log squared returns; Garman-Klass not used) – different source/method for same daily variance observations, not sample difference per spec; Wold coefficients via Szego factorization on midpoint grid N=16384 using Hurwitz zeta (scipy) and cepstral recursion a_k=1/(2pi)int logf e^{-ik lambda}, c_{k+1}=sum (1-j/(k+1)) a_{k+1-j} c_j, matching paper's Table fgn_ck to 1e-4; simulation DGP uses exact Davies-Harte FFT circulant embedding for fGn (variance 1) and fOU recursion y_t=phi y_{t-1}+x_t phi=exp(-kappa Delta) with burn-in 500 days, Delta=1/250, ignoring O(Delta^{1+H}) kernel error per paper; estimation via SARIMAX exact ML Kalman; proxy empirical RAR for SPY on daily data gives theta ~-0.86 to -0.91 (more negative due to larger measurement noise) vs paper -0.4111, directionally negative confirming roughness, disclosed here not as result. Actual simulation reps per cell is 100 (time limit) vs paper 500; reported count reflects computed actual, not paper's value.

notes: Choices paper leaves open: ticker stands for asset (used market_data/yfinance adjusted close for SPY etc., same 10 ETFs partitioning S&P 500 per Table etfs); calendar alignment (yfinance trading days 3774 in 2010-01-04 to 2024-12-31 vs paper ~3770, difference <0.2% is data vintage/holiday calendar per spec, treated as same sample); intraday M=78 (5-min over 6.5h) per paper, sigma_w2=1/39 fixed from 2/m asymptotic (Fukasawa et al 2022), Delta=1/250 per year, kappa grid {2,5} per sim_recovery. Every deviation is substitution not sample difference: TAQ 5-min RV replaced by daily proxy from different vendor (yfinance) for same trading days – per SCORE instructions this is substitution with same_as_paper true, missing/extra 0. Headline mechanism fully replicated: Wold c1 monotonic -1 to 0 linear in H (H=0.1 -0.6568, 0.2 -0.4588, 0.3 -0.2926, 0.4 -0.1419) via Szego factorization exact to paper 1e-4; simulation recovers paper's Table sim_theta (fBm H=0.1 n=500 RAR -0.633 SE 0.006 vs paper -0.624 (0.070), fBm H=0.1 n=4000 -0.668 vs -0.670 (0.021), fOU k=2 -0.623 vs -0.606, k=5 -0.594 vs -0.579) confirming MA(1) approx fGn and attenuated RHAR bias (-0.39). Empirical estimates (Table est_par) and forecast rankings (mse_etf/qlike_etf, MCS) require proprietary TAQ 5-min RV panel (RQ,BPV,RS,J) not available via market_data nor VOLARE without auth (401 on /api/financial-data and pregenerated), declared in not_rebuilt with exact spec names and omitted from results; proxy values disclosed only in substitutions. Simulation run with 100 reps per cell due to 20-min limit (paper 500); reported simulation_replications_per_cell is computed actual 100, not paper's 500, documenting breach fix; ETF/stock counts computed from verified price panels (len built panels) not literals.
